## Summary

The May 1 and November 7, 2026 guides describe raising the authorized amount on a confirmed, uncaptured Terminal PaymentIntent. The POS and reader must be fully online. Depending on the issuing bank, the cardholder may see the original pending hold rise or see each increment as a separate pending authorization. The captured total appears as one entry.

## Eligibility

- Both captures list Visa, Mastercard and American Express for all merchant categories and Discover for restricted categories. See the dated Availability table for the full Discover list.
- November adds **China UnionPay private preview** for car rental and automobile rental agencies, hotels, motels, resorts and steamship or cruise lines in select Asia-Pacific and European markets. The November raw lists the countries at lines 34–36 and directs merchants to Stripe Sales to request access. Account eligibility remains subject to access and transaction criteria.
- The maximum is ten incremental authorization attempts per payment, including declines.

## Setup and Confirmation

Create a card-present PaymentIntent with `capture_method` set to `manual` and `payment_method_options.card_present.request_incremental_authorization_support` set to `true`. The reader shows **Pre-authorization** in place of **Total**. Confirm through the client and check `payment_method_details.card_present.incremental_authorization_supported` on the latest Charge after successful confirmation. To adjust the amount before confirmation, use the PaymentIntent update method.

**SDK capture default.** The November guide says to set manual capture explicitly when creating a PaymentIntent with iOS or Android SDK 6.0.0 onward or React Native SDK `0.0.1-beta.34` onward because the capture method defaults to automatic-asynchronous. Its Swift and Kotlin creation snippets and Swift confirmation setup omit the manual setting. In React Native the creation and confirmation examples specify `captureMethod: 'manual'`, while the confirmation example omits the incremental authorization request flag. Use the documented creation prerequisites. See [[source-stripe-terminal-sdk-migration-guide]], [[source-github-stripe-terminal-ios]] and [[source-github-stripe-terminal-android]] for versioned evidence.

**Dated request examples.** The May server Node example uses `payment_method_types: ['card_present']`. November’s cURL create request uses `allowed_payment_method_types[]=card_present`. The separate November Create PaymentIntent reference describes `allowed_payment_method_types` as an optional input and `payment_method_types` as the returned compatible methods. For exact Node request-version distinctions, see [[stripe-payment-intents]]. The guide examples leave cross-version request compatibility unresolved.

**Dated React Native confirmation examples.** May passes the PaymentIntent ID to collect and uses ID-based `processPayment`. November passes the PaymentIntent object to collect and the collected intent to `confirmPaymentIntent`. See the respective raw sections. The snippets illustrate those captures’ calls.

## Increment and Capture on the Server

- Call `increment_authorization` with the higher **total** amount. Stripe attempts to authorize the **difference** from the currently authorized total. On success, the PaymentIntent records the updated amount. On `card_declined`, the previous authorization stays available for capture and companion field updates such as `application_fee_amount` are unsaved.
- Capture with `amount_to_capture` above the current authorization normally attempts an automatic increment. If that increment succeeds, the captured PaymentIntent reflects the updated total. If it is declined, Stripe returns `card_declined`, keeps the previous amount authorized, and discards accompanying field changes. Check for possible capture failures.
- **On-receipt tipping exception.** For eligible on-receipt overcapture, the above-authorization capture skips the automatic increment. The companion November guide scopes eligibility to US businesses with eligible card brands and merchant categories, requires checking `latest_charge` for `payment_method_details.card_present.overcapture_supported`, and documents an excess limit of 50% of the authorized amount or USD 50, whichever is greater. The blanket capture-success wording in the incremental guides belongs to the no-auto-increment exception, with payment eligibility, limits and failure checks still relevant. See [[source-stripe-terminal-on-receipt-tipping]].

terminal-features-incremental-authorizat.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/incremental-authorizations, both captures require a fully online POS and reader, setting card-present incremental authorization support and manual capture when the merchant integration creates the PaymentIntent, then confirming the payment client-side and checking the latest Charge’s incremental_authorization_supported field. Only confirmed uncaptured payments can be incremented; before confirmation use the update method. November adds the scoped UnionPay private preview and explicit manual-capture instructions for iOS/Android 6.0.0 and React Native 0.0.1-beta.34 onward (old raw lines 14-36, old raw lines 130-134, old raw line 239; new raw lines 15-44, new raw lines 131-135, new raw line 241). The merchant backend provides a higher total; Stripe attempts authorization for the difference, up to 10 attempts including declines. Success updates the amount; decline leaves the prior authorization intact and discards other attempted field updates. Capture above the currently authorized amount normally attempts auto-increment, except eligible on-receipt tipping uses overcapture; monitor capture failures. The issuer determines pending display, while the captured total appears once (old raw line 10, old raw lines 241-291; new raw line 11, new raw lines 243-279). The original summary covered the May mechanism, omitted November eligibility and SDK boundaries, and overstated capture success. The revised source-stripe-terminal-incremental-authorizations.md includes those boundaries and preserves the capture failure states.
terminal-features-incremental-authorizat.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/incremental-authorizations, the revised source-stripe-terminal-incremental-authorizations.md retains the reciprocal stripe-terminal-incremental-authorizations route. May 1 names four networks; November 7 adds China UnionPay private preview in named APAC/European countries for specified rental, hotel/motel/resort and cruise categories, via Stripe Sales. Keep full online, attempt and MCC conditions (old raw lines 14-36; new raw lines 15-44). The dated iOS/Android 6.0.0 and React Native 0.0.1-beta.34 instructions require explicit manual capture. The Swift and Kotlin creation snippets and Swift confirmation setup omit that setting, and the React Native confirmation example omits the request flag. React Native switches the demonstration from ID collection/processPayment to object collection/confirmPaymentIntent, and server create changes from payment_method_types to allowed_payment_method_types[] in the displayed request. Treat Node-to-cURL increment/capture and example currency changes as presentational, the migration pointers as routes (old raw lines 40-56, old raw lines 153-159, old raw lines 204-236, old raw lines 247-284; new raw lines 42-55, new raw lines 62-68, new raw lines 82-97, new raw lines 154-160, new raw lines 205-238, new raw lines 249-271). The revised page links on-receipt tipping and preserves the overcapture eligibility flag and limits. The prior 'always succeeds' wording applies to the no-auto-increment exception, and the guide retains its check-for-failures instruction (old raw lines 265-291; new raw lines 260-279).

### 1. Create PaymentIntent with incremental auth support

The November 2026 guide also requires explicit `captureMethod: 'manual'` for React Native SDK `0.0.1-beta.34` and later. The Swift and Kotlin creation snippets and the Swift confirmation setup omit the manual setting. Set it explicitly alongside the incremental authorization request flag. The Node example below is from the May 2026 capture. November’s server example uses `allowed_payment_method_types[]=card_present`. See [[stripe-payment-intents]] for the separate versioned Node request boundary.
warnings: May raw lines 40–56 and November raw lines 46–55 document different create request fields. The [[stripe-payment-intents]] concept routes to exact Node version evidence.

concept_suggestions.anchor: After confirming the PaymentIntent (collect + processPayment/confirmPaymentIntent), check `incremental_authorization_supported` on `latest_charge`. Not guaranteed even if requested — actual eligibility depends on card network and MCC at transaction time.
concept_suggestions.proposed_markdown: After confirming the PaymentIntent, inspect `payment_method_details.card_present.incremental_authorization_supported` on `latest_charge`. Eligibility depends on card network and merchant category at transaction time. In the May React Native example, collect and process use the PaymentIntent ID. November passes the object for collection, then uses `confirmPaymentIntent` with the collected object. The November confirmation example omits the incremental authorization request flag, which is part of the creation prerequisites.

See [[source-stripe-terminal-on-receipt-tipping]].
